assertions.name: bare_count_is_uniquely_n_stable
assertions.unit: candidate mode-count functionals with n-flat rel-h² deviation
assertions.source: disjoint unknot count is q-independent; |rel-h²| spread over n=2..8 — bare_count 0, jones_unlink 0.188, wenzl_unnorm 1 ⇒ n-stable set = ['bare_count']

assertions.name: prefactor_n_sum_regulator_independent
assertions.source: S(ε) - 6/ε⁴ → ζ(-3) = 1/120 via exponential cutoff (physical regulator), independent of ζ-continuation

description: Sub-problem 1 attempt for conj:casimir-epsilon-vacuum. n-stability selection uniquely picks the bare disjoint-unknot count (no y_λ); the geometric n³ degeneracy + ζ(-3) derives π²/720. Conditional on the free-field ↔ disjoint-unknot identification, ξ_k = 0 at leading order.

selection_principle.criterion: n-stability — a single-number observable cannot depend on the mode-cutoff n; functionals whose substrate-deviation grows with n are inadmissible.

free_field_disjoint_identification.statement: Maxwell linearity ⇒ photon vacuum modes non-interacting ⇒ unbraided = disjoint unknots. Disjoint unknots carry linking_weight=1 and NO y_λ weighting, so the mode-count is the bare count = the unique n-stable functional.
free_field_disjoint_identification.status: MODELING IDENTIFICATION (well-motivated), not a QOU theorem.

prefactor_derivation.route: disjoint count + geometric per-level degeneracy ∝ n³ + ζ-regularization of the mode tower
prefactor_derivation.note: q appears NOWHERE; π²/720 derived with no Hecke y_λ.

conditional_conclusion.IF: free-field ↔ disjoint-unknot identification AND n-stability admissibility
conditional_conclusion.THEN: ξ_k = 0 for all k ≥ 1 at leading 1/d⁴ order; π²/720 prefactor derived.
conditional_conclusion.where_q_corrections_live: braided modes = field interactions = QED loops = subleading 1/d⁶ order; a DIFFERENT coefficient, not ξ_2 of the leading term.
conditional_conclusion.relation_to_retracted_closure: Refines (does not restore) the 'Casimir isn't Hecke' closure: Casimir IS in the knot framework, as disjoint unknots whose trace functional is the trivial count.

regulator_independence.purpose: show the cubic-mode-sum value 1/120 = ζ(-3) is regulator-independent (physical), not a ζ-continuation artefact.
regulator_independence.bernoulli_bridge: 1/(e^ε-1)=Σ B_k ε^{k-1}/k!; the -ε³/720=B₄ε³/4! term gives (-d/dε)³ → +1/120. Same B₄=-1/30 as ζ(-3)=-B₄/4 in CasimirZetaPrefactor.lean. Regulator route ≡ Bernoulli/ζ route.

leading_scaling.note: archimedean (q-free) leading term; q re-enters only at the interacting 1/d⁶ order via the figure-eight weight J_{4₁}(q) (conj:casimir-first-q-correction).

caveats: Conditional construction. Identifies the trace functional (bare count) and the selection principle (n-stability); does NOT build the full Yekutieli-homotopy lift. ξ_k=0 holds conditional on the free-field ↔ disjoint-unknot identification, which is a modeling statement. The per-level n³ degeneracy and the π²/6 k_⊥ factor are transported from standard free-field mode counting, not derived from the substrate.
